 ☐ Colour

Which made-up colour scheme should the made-up widget use?

❯ 1. Glimmerfrost Teal with soft Vellumshade borders and a bright Quillberry
     accent on hover states
     A cool palette built around the invented Glimmerfrost Teal. Borders use
     pale Vellumshade grey. Buttons glow Quillberry red when the pointer moves
     over them, so actions stand out clearly.
  2. Duskmoth Amber with deep Brindlewood panels and calm Oakmist text for long
     reading sessions
     A warm palette based on the invented Duskmoth Amber. Panels use dark
     Brindlewood brown for depth. Text uses Oakmist cream, which keeps contrast
     high and reduces eye strain over long sessions.
  3. Zephyrine Violet with crisp Snowpetal backgrounds and sharp Coppervane
     highlights for key status badges
     A light palette that uses the invented Zephyrine Violet as its main colour.
     Backgrounds stay clean Snowpetal white. Status badges use Coppervane
     orange, so warnings and success states are easy to see.
